# Supplier Continuity Evidence

## Purpose

Evaluate whether material supplier resilience claims are supported by evidence appropriate to dependency risk.

## Requirements

Evidence MAY include current continuity plans, test summaries, recovery commitments, incident history, dependency disclosures, or other artifacts proportionate to criticality.

A generic marketing statement about resilience is not equivalent to tested capability.

Evidence age and scope should be considered before relying on it.
